sentences.en: Many small business owners belong to a chamber of commerce.
sentences.zh: 许多小企业主加入了商会。

sentences.en: Along with Tokyo, Osaka is a center of commerce.
sentences.zh: 除了东京，大阪也是商业中心。

sentences.en: It is often said that Osaka is a city of commerce.
sentences.zh: 人们常说大阪是一座商业城市。

senses.zh: 贸易，商业；<旧>社交，交往；<旧>性交
